heroCatalog.pack: Botaniq Full 7.2 deciduous (already purchased / lookdev-intake listed)
heroCatalog.note: Lookdev intake lists Fagus/Salix summer hero .blends, but the unpaid Botaniq extract on this host has grass/misc/mosses/plants/rocks/shrubs only. Production recovery only rebinds EcoKit Tree_* bark. It never replaces EcoKit canopies with Botaniq trees.
